title: Certus Composable Server Configuration
description: JSON configuration schema for certus-server-composable. Defines components, bindings, variables, and server settings.

variables.description: Named integer values for substitution in instance count fields.

search_paths.description: Ordered list of directories to search for dylib files. CERTUS_LIB_PATH env var is prepended.

server.description: Server-level settings. CLI arguments override these values.

tls_key.description: Path to TLS private key file.

drive_count.description: Auto-select first N discovered NVMe drives.

format.description: Format extent managers on startup (destroys existing data).

poller_base_cpu.description: Base CPU core for NVMe poller thread pinning.

components.description: Component declarations. Each entry defines a component type to load and instantiate.

name.description: Unique identifier for this component (referenced in bindings).

path.description: Absolute path override. If provided, search_paths are not consulted for this component.

instances.description: Number of instances to create. Integer literal or '$variable_name' reference.

bindings.description: Wiring rules connecting component interfaces to receptacles.

target.description: Name of the component that has the receptacle.

receptacle.description: Name of the receptacle slot on the target component.

source.description: Name of the component that provides the required interface.

init_order.description: Optional explicit initialization order. Must be a valid topological ordering of the binding dependency graph.
